spans.s:
m. (-रिः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆ

The planet SATURN.
E.
शूर a proper name or a hero, इञ् aff.

m. (-रिः)
SATURN.
E.
सूर the sun, and इञ् aff. of descent.

mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं)
Measured by a winnowing basket, &c.
E.
शूर्प्प a basket, अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शौर्प्पिक.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Valour, heroism, prowess.
2 The heroic drama, or that which treats of war, magic, &c.
E.
शूर a hero, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Acquired by valour.
E.
शौर्य्य, and उपार्ज्जित acquired.

Solar.
2

Celestial.
3

Spirituous.
m. (-रः)
1 The planet

SATURN.
2

A month, consisting of thirty rising and settings of the sun, a solar month.
3 A solar day, whilst the sun is in one degree of the ecliptic.
f. (-री)
The wife of the sun.
E.
सुर a deity, &c., मूर the sun, अण् aff., or सूर्य्य the sun, and ङीष् aff. for the fem. form.

Fragrance.
2

Saffron.
E.
सुरभि fragrant, अण् aff.

m. (-यः)
An ox.
f. (-यी)
A cow.
E.
सुरभी the cow of plenty, (the parent cow,) and ढक् aff. of descent.

n. (-भ्यं)
1 Pleasingness, agreeableness, beauty.
2 Fragrance, odour.
3 Fame, character, reputation of learning or other merit.
m. (-भ्यः)
KUVERA.
E.
सुरभि fragrant, pleasing, and ण्यत् aff.

m. (-यः)
A name of SKANDA.
E.
सुरसा DURGĀ, and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Gangetic, relating or belonging to the Ganges river.
E.
सुरसिन्धु the river of the gods, and अण् added.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
Surat.
f. (-ष्ट्री)
A fragrant sort of earth.
n. (-ष्ट्रं)
Bell metal.
E.
सु good or much, राष्ट्र dominion, अञ् aff.; or सुराष्ट्र the same, and अण् pleonasm.

n. (-कं)
A sort of white or bell metal.
E.
सौराष्ट्र Surat, and कन् added.

n. (-कं)
A sort of poison, (that of a kind of snake according to some, but according to others, a vegetable or mineral.)
E.
सुराष्ट्र the country, and ठक् aff.

Celestial.
2

Spirituous, vinous.
m. (-कः)
1 Heaven, paradise.
2 A vender of spirituous liquor.
E.
सुर a deity, or सुरा wine, and ठक् aff.
